subject: Private Offer: reseller operational roles & billing coordination
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cloudresell.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: reseller operational roles & billing coordination

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for agreeing to resell our Channel Private Offer (CPPO) for the Acme deployment. To make the activation smooth we need to lock down a few operational pieces on your side and ours. Can you confirm the items below and attach any artifacts we should ingest into the HubSpot deal?

- Billing route: who will receive invoices (email + billing entity)? Do you issue consolidated invoices to customers or route invoices to Redwood?
- PO/Contract signatory: legal name, billing address, and whether you need a Redwood PO sample (we can provide).
- Tax docs: W-9 / VAT forms for your reseller entity.
- Technical entitlement: will you manage entitlement mapping or do you want Redwood to invoice end customers and pass-through?
- Compliance evidence: reseller certification we require for private offers (short checklist attached).

Attached: reseller_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, invoice_routing_instructions.pdf

If it's easier, happy to do a 30-min sync tomorrow. Proposed times: Thu 06/03 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Channel Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173

--
Attachment: reseller_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
Attachment: invoice_routing_instructions.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

Subject: Re: Private Offer: reseller operational roles & billing coordination

Connor — thanks for the clear checklist. We're aligned on most items; answers inline below and attaching our standard reseller packet.

- Billing route: CloudResell issues consolidated invoices to the end customer and then invoices Redwood for committed usage monthly. We can also support routing invoices directly to Redwood if required by your finance policy.
- PO/Contract signatory: CloudResell LLC (EIN: 12-3456789). I'll attach our billing address and sample PO.
- Tax docs: attaching our VAT certificate and W9 for US entity.
- Technical entitlement: we prefer to own entitlement mapping at the reseller layer for this initial wave. We can revisit after Q1.
- Compliance evidence: see reseller_certification.pdf attached.

I'll schedule the 30-min call for Thu 06/03 at 10:00am PT. Does that work for your team?

Elena Rossi
Head of Channel Ops | CloudResell Co.
elena.rossi@cloudresell.co | +44 20 7946 0123

Team — quick internal note before the call:

1) Marissa — can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a consolidated reseller invoice in the CPPO flow? If yes, do we need the reseller to be listed on the invoice as the bill-to or as an intermediary?
2) If Redwood must be the direct bill-to for Marketplace settlement reasons, we'll need to request CloudResell to change routing for the initial quarter and submit a revised PO.
3) Lauren — please make sure we have the HubSpot deal updated with the CloudResell billing entity and DocuSign link once Elena sends it.

I'll join the 10:00am PT call.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: reseller operational roles & billing coordination

Hi Elena — thanks, this is helpful. Short answers from finance/legal:

- Redwood can accept consolidated invoices from a reseller, provided the invoice includes the Redwood Account ID and a line-item breakdown by end-customer (we need that for revenue recognition). Example attached (PO_example.pdf).
- For Marketplace CPPOs, AWS requires the seller to be listed on settlement records. We will accept CloudResell-issued invoices if CloudResell is the bill-to and includes the Marketplace order ID in the invoice metadata.
- Please complete the reseller onboarding DocuSign (link below) so Legal can finalize the reseller addendum.

DocuSign for reseller addendum: https://www.docusign.com/contract/abc123

If you want, we can farm the first two months through a direct invoicing model to simplify the initial go-live and then transition to consolidated invoices after the first settlement.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

--

Elena
